name: 37 activities map to 10 L01 standards, with high-school subjects separated
Elementary controls exclude vectors, angles and torque
Same push, heavier cart travels less
Balance and scale have separate measurement procedures
Tools trade force for distance at the same 0.5 m lift
Zero net force preserves prior velocity
Earth and Moon change weight, not mass
Same suspended load: stiffness changes extension, not force
Friction onset is a controlled static measurement
Buoyancy and apparent weight sum to true weight
Net force zero is insufficient when net torque is nonzero
Support distinguishes inside, edge and outside
Incline limiting friction, normal force and tension balance
School and activity records do not alias
Reload preserves conditions, notes and all course records
Import recomputes measurements and rejects cross-course or invalid inputs
Every activity default and boundary produces finite numeric measurements
